stage: Implemented and engineering-checked locally; independent QA pending. Billing activation, commercial terms, merchant configuration and actual provider acceptance remain separate.
customerJob: A verified owner reviews the exact monthly service offer, enters payment only through hosted Stripe Checkout, returns to confirmed payment status and can stop monthly renewal without founder configuration.
authority: User asked to fix all launch blockers. Root assigned billing engineering; no live account configuration, provider calls, customer charges or publication authorized by this slice.

environment: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY supports sk_test_,rk_test_,sk_live_,rk_live_; live keys additionally need WORKSPACE_BILLING_LIVE_ENABLED=true

schema.version: operator-approved stable version; no arbitrary daily renewal
schema.stripeAccountId: exact approved merchant account, validated by GET /v1/account

terms.text: full approved service terms,100-20000characters; shown and accepted, no default commercial language

starter.services: nonempty subset of web,voice,sms,calendar covering all selected customer connections
starter.limitsDescription: approved clear explanation; no invented included allowances

offerContract.stripePriceRequirements: Active matching test/live USD recurring month,interval_count1,licensed,per_unit,exact unit_amount9900/24900,tax_behavior inclusive. Checkout adds no trial, promotion, metering, shipping or tax amount.
offerContract.activation: Requires explicit approved offer and actual selected/offered service readiness. Existing provider safety limits must exactly match declared maxima. Approval/version is global, not a founder approval per customer.
permissions: Checkout Sessions read/write (create and same-session expiry)
Subscriptions read/write only cancel_at_period_end=true; no unscoped subscription update
offerContract.excluded: No Product/Price/Customer writes, global branding changes, Billing Portal configuration, payment-method reads, invoice mutations, usage-meter events, refunds or invented allowance/overage rates.

implemented: Authenticated same-origin owner-only GET saved status and POST review/checkout/status/cancel endpoints. Current session is reread immediately before Checkout dispatch.
Immutable tenant+actor+configuration+offer+terms+parameters persisted before one idempotent Checkout POST. Parallel/replayed requests reuse the same attempt; no ownerKey appears in returned URLs.
Unknown Checkout creation retries the same parameters/key only within23hours; later outcomes are searched/reconciled or held, never blindly recreated after Stripe retention.
Known pre-dispatch validation failures safely abandon unsent attempts and permit new explicit review; old attempts/subscriptions/cancellations remain in bounded immutable history.

Webhook signature uses exact raw bytes, fresh timestamp and any matching v1 signature for rotation. Duplicate event IDs retain their digest; event snapshots only trigger authoritative session/subscription reconciliation under a workspace lease.

Financial customer/subscription identities, mode, metadata, amount,currency and one exact Price/quantity are checked. Older event snapshots cannot regress current provider state, and tenant replacement cannot inherit billing.

Ending renewal persists a durable request. Ordinary scheduled recovery reconciles unknown results and can safely renew an aged cancellation key only after an authoritative read because its semantic mutation only sets cancel_at_period_end=true.

Stopping the front desk durably requests ending renewal and expires the same open unpaid Checkout. Unknown/lost expiry recovers through the ordinary scheduler; an already-paid race is retained and renewal ends without activating a stopped workspace.
Verified canceled/incomplete-expired subscriptions permit a fresh explicitly reviewed checkout using the existing bound Stripe customer.

Separate Account billing module shows offer, agreement, secure Checkout, returning status and keep/end-renewal dialog. Session loss or allowed sign-out prevents stale navigation; deferred Account sign-out preserves module responsiveness.
Legacy key GET cannot reach self-service billing; legacy webhook slug metadata cannot mutate self-service customers. Legacy billing behavior is otherwise retained.

Existing managed SMS actual-handler regression after the stop-service hook; intercepted provider protocol only.

sources.applied: Persist same parameters/key; do not assume APIv1 retention beyond24hours.
Raw-body signature validation, timestamp tolerance, duplicates and event ordering.
Hosted subscription Checkout and metadata, fixed Price/quantity, session identity and expiry.
Expire the same open Checkout when service stops.

limits: No provider requests, private-key reads, payment, purchase, Stripe account/product/price configuration, environment change or deployment occurred.

Synthetic offer and tax behavior exist only to test strict contracts. They are not approved customer commercial terms or approved included usage. Live paid activation remains disabled until reviewed scope/cost/caps/tax terms and the correct Stripe setup are approved and verified.

Stripe and workspace storage cannot form one atomic transaction. A payment already completing concurrently with Stop is retained as a paid exception, renewal is ended automatically and the stopped workspace is never activated. Refund decisions remain owner-controlled; no refund is promised.
The new billing state records financial truth and never certifies a service delivery or automatically activates a connection. Provider/customer launch acceptance remains separate.
Physical Stripe test-mode protocol acceptance, production webhooks and financial/support exception receipt are unaccepted by local checks.
